messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Good news, David, it's already there. All four Bitfortun BS-1 units shipped September 7 and were delivered to (address hidden) on September 23, in four Yun Express parcels.

Here's one of the tracking links if you want to see the delivery scan: (tracking link hidden)

Did all four boxes arrive?
Hello, I have received all three miners. Unfortunately one of them was delivered with a German power cable and not a Swiss.
Handed to the team · packing error (wrong-region cable) plus a possible missing fourth unit on a deli

Sorry about that, David. A Swiss cable is going out to you, no need to return anything.

One thing though: your order was four BS-1 units in four separate parcels, and you've got three. I've asked the team to trace the fourth one.

They're offline right now and pick this up today at 10am Eastern, and the answer comes to (email hidden), so you don't need to wait here.

Can you confirm three boxes arrived, not four?
I mean all four have been delivered
Handed to the team · correcting the earlier flag: nothing is missing, only the wrong cable

Perfect, all four accounted for then. I've called off the trace.

So it's just the cable. A Swiss one is being sent out to you, nothing to return, and the German one is yours to keep or bin.

The team picks this up today at 10am Eastern and confirms the cable to (email hidden) Anything else on the three you've set up so far?

You're welcome, David. Sorry for the mix-up on the cable.

A copy of this whole conversation comes to your email once we're done, and you can reply to it if anything else comes up with the BS-1s. Enjoy the mining.
